releases.notes:
## v1.0.0 Release

> [!WARNING]
> The version the mod supports is 1.21.8 and the versions above 1.21.8 are experimental only. Support for 1.21.x will be added soon.

Main features include:

- True Network Monitoring: Tracks real-time Ping and Jitter to gauge connection stability.
- Desync Detection: Automatically analyzes entity interactions (swings vs. damage registration) to detect server-side processing delays. Classifies states as Synced, Minor Desync, or Severe Desync.
- Informative HUDs: Visual overlays for immediate feedback on network health and sync status.
- Client-Side Only: Works on any server without installation required on the server side.
- HUD Editor: The position and view of the HUDs can be edited in-game using the HUD editor.

> [!NOTE]
> Note that due to server limitations, Korenet can only update the HUD every 3-5 seconds when the tab refreshes. I'm working on a better  solution to get the ping and jitter and any help would be appreciated.
